experiences.description: Worked on the design, implementation, and evaluation of a RAG-based question-answering system for technical PDF documents.
responsibilities: Developed a retrieval pipeline combining query routing, hybrid retrieval, and contextual reranking.
Implemented backend and retrieval components using Python, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL with pgvector.
Built a web application prototype with authentication, document management, chat history, and citation-based document navigation.
